description.en: Intended to check whether a party member's GP (Guts Points) gauge is maxed out, by handle. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/. Its native implementation does read the member's GP value internally, but that value doesn't appear to feed into the traced return below — treat the exact check semantics with caution.

True once the handle resolves to a party member (the internal GP-max comparison doesn't visibly affect the returned value in the decompiled code); null if the call was invalid or the handle doesn't resolve to a party member.
